KanbanTask.title: KanbanTask
KanbanTask.description: A scheduled user task tracked across Kanban workflow columns (PENDENTE, INICIADO, CONCLUIDO).

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID matching the parent user document.

description.description: Optional detailed task notes (0 to 500 characters).

category.description: Category label for task organization (1 to 40 characters).

scheduledAt.description: Optional scheduled due date and time stored as a Firestore Timestamp.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User-scoped Kanban tasks collection isolated per authenticated Firebase user.
